obstruction.statement: After finite I supplies the expanding-ball good-time reservoir G_R, the Albritton-Barker Liouville consumer still needs a uniformly bounded global L3 norm at the same selected times; the missing term is the L3 far tail outside B_{2R}.
obstruction.falsifier: Produce a source-bound theorem deriving the required same-time tail bound directly from finite I, or show the core/tail decomposition does not match Theorem 1.2.

trigger_signature: consumer asks for backward time-slice L3 bound
lesson.action: Before searching for global compactness, average C over a far-back slab to extract a positive-measure set of times with uniformly bounded L3 mass on the expanding core; then isolate only the same-time spatial tail as the residual.
expected_effects: shrinks a broad global-critical-state-space obligation to a tail-only gluing atom
creates a temporal-density interface that can intersect an independent tail-good set
boundaries: does not bound the far tail
does not apply to Type-II branches without finite I
does not grant canonical memory authority
validation_obligations: source recheck of exact theorem signature
any later tail producer must be same-theory and same-time
